name: workflow-manager
description: Context-efficient workflow management with adaptive routing, output guardrails, compaction recovery, and bounded subagent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Manage complex work with bounded context and agents.
interface.longDescription: Guides multi-step work through Contract, Evidence, Change, Verify, and Report; re-audits newly independent lanes before delegation; preserves routes across progress updates and compaction; closes delegation for shared-resource chains; and guards oversized or noisy tool output.
defaultPrompt: Use $workflow-manager to complete this task through the smallest relevant Contract, Evidence, Change, Verify, and Report stages.
Preserve progress across compaction, avoid repeating verified work, bound command output, and report only material phase changes or long waits.
Delegate only independent ready-now work: re-audit when a new non-overlapping read-only lane emerges, count the parent as one lane, and keep shared build/device chains serialized.
